l.why: query-token substring hit mass on stripped lines; hits are sorted descending and the top min(3,n) / total is kept. Line order and inter-line distance are discarded. Not positional evidence locality.

p.why: path/version/line-number regex hits on the whole text

s.why: JSON/CSV/code heuristics on the whole text

u.why: derived from a and (1-l); rule-Π records u but does not route on it
